post.text: The No Kings crowds were crazy! https://t.co/iAeMcDYNj5

description.description: A high-angle, wide-shot photograph from behind Freddie Mercury on stage during the Live Aid concert at Wembley Stadium in 1985. Mercury is facing a massive, dense crowd that fills the stadium, wearing his iconic white tank top and light-colored jeans with one arm raised in the air. In the background, a small control tower and several distant structures are visible among the sea of spectators. Large black stage monitors line the front edge of the stage platform.
